The gap the IIF specifically targets is a financing-cost gap. Indian shipyards report borrowing at roughly 10–10.5% for ship construction loans, against roughly 4–8% for Chinese yards ... and roughly 5–6% in South Korea. That spread alone is estimated to add 15–20% to the cost of a ship built in India
